method: Explicit-target flre.py and Capstone disassembly, Delphi published-method names and RTTI VMT pointers, plus sigscan unique signatures. This file contains addresses and observations, not binary code.

address_corrections.name: SETPROJ
observations: The accepted target preserves the form, two qword UnicodeString arguments, and byte addRecent argument. It assigns two project-path globals using the same Delphi string helper, calls the published UpdatePathLabels method, and preserves the 49-entry recent-project list loop.
Reference globals 0x156f298 and 0x156f2a0 correspond to target 0x16c0c90 and 0x16c0c98. The MAINFORM references match the independent address map.
Both versions have callers in the published RenameProjectBtnClick and ProjDataPathBtnClick handlers.
The rejected candidate shares only a stack-probe prologue. Its second argument is a dword, and its body enters different loading/busy logic. A short unique prefix is insufficient evidence here.

abi_reviews.name: SAVEPROJ
observations: Reference sites 0x10cdf8c and 0x10cdfdb preserve the path in RCX and byte flags in DL; target sites 0x11db8dc and 0x11db92b preserve the same arguments and both allocate a 0x98-byte frame.

The target captures no incoming R8 or R9 value before its first nested call at 0x11db936. At 0x11db9eb it supplies saved path, zero mask/object values, and saved flags to mapped SAVEPRESET at 0xf54600.

The reduced automatic similarity reflects the reference protector jump at 0x10cdfe2 before the body, and does not indicate new mandatory incoming arguments. Runtime save success remains a separate test.

changed_layouts.name: MIX_STRIDE
changed_layouts.observation: The matched MUTE function indexes a mixer record using 0x51d times 4 in the reference and 0x28f times 8 in the target. Its full-track reset loop independently increments by 0x1474 and 0x1478 respectively.

changed_layouts.name: MIX_SLOTS_OFF
changed_layouts.observation: MIXNAME traverses ten qword effect-slot objects using this displacement, preserving the per-object name and VMT name-setter call. SETROUTE independently accesses the same target slot region.

changed_layouts.name: MIX_ROUTE
changed_layouts.observation: SETROUTE calculates source-record base plus this displacement, indexes destination entries at eight-byte intervals, and reads/writes the enabled flag at entry plus four. An aggregate histogram incorrectly favors unchanged 0x2e4 because unrelated structures use that value.

project_vmt.source: Class pointer in Delphi class RTTI with the exact shortstring name TFLProject.

entries.name: FLPROJ_LOAD_SLOT
entries.observation: Both accept form, qword path in RDX, and byte flags in R8; classify against an eight-entry extension list, use flag one for the save-changes prompt and flag two for the underlying load call. Target slot 0x38 points to 0xed5cd0, which instead accepts a byte selector in DL and path in R9, so reusing the old slot is an ABI error.

unchanged_layouts.observation: PATNAME and NOTEARR both index by eight times three times eight; an adjacent full-table loop independently increments by 0xc0 until 1000 records.

unchanged_layouts.observation: NOTEARR tests, creates, and returns the note-array object at this pattern record displacement.

tooling_candidates.name: FORMADDMARK
tooling_candidates.observation: Unique 27-byte signature and function-order anchors agree. Body forwards marker position/name/action/time-signature arguments through the form's marker-list pointer.

tooling_candidates.name: PL_MARKERS
tooling_candidates.observation: FORMADDMARK reads the form's marker-list pointer at 0xd84. Selected-marker writes at 0xd8c independently establish the neighboring PL_MARKSEL field.

tooling_candidates.name: MSGBOX_WRAPPER
tooling_candidates.observation: The first twelve bytes match the existing msgbox mode-one guard; its call at 0x96368c reaches mapped MSGBOX_CORE 0x9635f0.

remaining_validation: Static layout and method correspondence does not establish safe end-to-end project synchronization or operation replay.
Verify project join/load, all six pattern operations, mixer routing/effects, markers, note edits and sample transfer in disposable test sessions before enabling ordinary builds.
Piano-roll geometry and all unreviewed object fields still need targeted runtime or static validation; aggregate offset counts alone cannot establish object identity.
Preserve default compile gating until compatibility tests pass.
